authors: Ödeen A, Håstad O, Alström P
title: Evolution of ultraviolet vision in the largest avian radiation - the passerines: Additional file 1 (species list with SWS1 class)
why: Already wanted for other passerines; also add Pardalotus. The article text names several Australo-Papuan taxa (Amytornis, Malurus, Menura, Pomatostomus, Ailuroedus) but not Pardalotus; only the species list can show whether a pardalote was sequenced. An SWS1 sequence predicts the pigment class and would grade g at most.
get: open access: additional files on the journal page

Title and year are from that reference list; volume pages and DOI not confirmed.
